title: ononis serrata subsp. cossoniana
intro: Ononis serrata subsp. cossoniana, commonly known as Ononis cossoniana, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its therapeutic properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ononis serrata subsp. cossoniana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-diarrheal and anti-constipation properties. The health benefits of Ononis serrata subsp. cossoniana include its potential to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activities.
